Example Robotics Collective

We are a student team of over 60 members building autonomous robots for intercollegiate competitions. Our mission is to make hands-on robotics accessible to every Harvard undergraduate, regardless of prior experience.

Get involved

Applications for Fall 2026 are open. The deadline is October 3, 2026 at 11:59 PM ET.

Last year we received 180 applicants for about 30 spots.
